source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When this unit opts to [Remain Stationary](vsdata:core-rule/remain-stationary) during your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), equip its Shas’ui with the support turret. It keeps that weapon up to the start of your following turn. **Designer’s Note**: Mark the weapon with a support turret token beside the unit.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
